title: Conversation 2026-10-24: seeing my words become elements; narrative explorations become the standard

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: The owner on the core working problem of speed without context, affirming with a tick or a deny where they write, the first real essay, the editor's layers and stance, the programme as a database, and narrative explorations becoming the standard. This note is the conversation's identity record; the vignettes are the owner's words.
